answer: Kinship walls gate every attestation: only established non-kin peers count toward rewards. Sock puppets share fingerprints — creation bursts, correlated grading, one genetic pigment — and kin detection sweeps them into a single family. A raven flock of a hundred accounts raised together counts as one voice; four extra kin signatures buy nothing. Eligibility demands five established strangers, so a farm must win over the very community it aims to defraud, wandering apart like dunes across a windy desert. Attacker cost: manufacturing unrelated standing from zero, per farm, every time.
